product_one_liner.value: Gushwork provides AI-powered marketing agents and tools that help small and midsize businesses—especially B2B companies—improve online and AI-search visibility and generate qualified inbound leads.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes agents for SMBs; its site also describes AI/search visibility, website/content creation, and lead generation.

pricing_page.notes: Public page gives a starting price of $900/month and describes pricing factors.

named_customers.notes: All three names appear among the company's case studies.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn shows 51–200 employees, while an October 2026 job listing describes a team of about 90 people; this supports the 51–100 band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists San Francisco, California as the company headquarters. The company also lists an Indian office.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index consists of practical marketing, SEO, and lead-generation guides, not technical product-building posts by engineers.

public_docs.notes: The homepage/footer links to product, pricing, company, and legal pages but no public product documentation, help center, or developer portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A job board is linked, but the available live listings could not be checked sufficiently to establish whether a qualifying AI/ML/data-science role is open.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed the product site, blog, and publicly linked privacy policy; no public statement naming an AI model or model provider was found.

compliance_certs.notes: The site links legal/privacy pages but does not display any of the specified compliance certifications.

last_funding.notes: Company announcement dated February 26, 2026 reports a $9 million seed round.

raised_18mo.notes: The $9 million seed round announced February 26, 2026 falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board lists Business Development Representative and Account Executive roles.

launched_6mo.notes: The announcements page lists a July 21, 2026 product launch, within the six months before the run date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No sufficiently verifiable dated evidence of a C-level or VP-level join or departure within the period was found, and the available team information was insufficient to support a negative.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The company's job board is readable; no CRM or sales/marketing system name was established from the available job-board information.
